translation.name: New Testament in the Yaka language (Congo-Brazzaville)

book.name: 1 Timoteo
book.title: Mukaanda a Pawuli wa tsiomi kwaa Timoteo

content: Mandoongi kwaa mukuutu a libuundu
A sieembe pe inunu mu ibaala, ka hamisa nde weti ti nde li taayi a we. Na holo bafuru weti baana ba nguu ba we baba baala,
Bakaasa ba binunu weti ba nguu ba we, na banduumbu weti bakeri ba we. Yiluu buu mu mutimi watsieeme.
Baasila mu likiinzi loosi bakwiili babahele na libaasila.

Ka so mukwiili li na baana so bateeri, bo ni batsiomi babafwaana umweese imiini kia bo mu nzo a bomo. Ni mu buu, bo sa bavutulu kwaa bataayi na banguu ba bo, libaasili li bo baholi kwaa bo. Maa ni mandaa mali mu uha Nziaambi kinyi.
Mukwiili wuli ngwanya nde bake, wahele na muutu wu ubaasila nde, asuusu ilimbisi kia nde mu Nziaambi. Nde li mu ukuundu Nziaambi nyanga na butsuu, mu uloombo libaasila kwaa nde.
Ka mukwiili wuli mu uba ndila na matsimi ma uyaangisa mutimi a nde mu manzala ma tsi, nde amaakwakwa, so bu ali moonyi.
Libili bo moonyi mu mandaa maa moosi, paa bo bahele na bisieembi.
So muutu nyaali mu ubaasila kaanda la nde, na vulu-vulu baata ba nzo a nde, nde maabwiisi imiini kia nde, na nde maavulu mungooyi bubi.
Mu uba mu kaba la bakwiili, bubwe ti mukaasa atooso bilimi maku masamina. Tumake nde afwaana uba mukaasa wali wanambata mu baala limosi.
Na nde afwaana uyabina mu mimibwe mi nde ayilii: nde akulusu baana ba nde bubwe, akiyaka bieenyi bubwe, aswayi mili mia bangaa imiini
, abaasili baata babali mu pasi, na nde ayilii kwaa baata boosi mamabwe.
Mundaa yatala bakwiili babafuru, asuusu pe bo mu litaanga la bakwiili. Mundaa ti nha manzala ma bo mali mu utsindi bo mu ukweele, bo bali mu utakuu na Kristo.
Mu yii, bo bali mu uholo tsieembili, mundaa ti bo aba bakebe pe imiini kia tsiomi ki bo basi kwaa Kristo.

Nha yulu a nhaa, bu bo bahele na isala kia usa, bo bali na ipfu kia uyooyene mu manzo-manzo. Ka kiabwavulu bubi, bo batoono utsuu mu bambaayi na bo matsweeyi pe. Bo bubaatsuu mu mandaa mahele utala bo.
Ni mu buu, me natoono ti bakwiili bakeni bafuru babwakweele, babutu baana, na basalila ma nzo ma bo. Mu yii, bo a buha pe mbuu kwaa Mutaata
mu utsuu bubi mu bisi.
Mundaa ti bakwiili bakimi ba bafuru, bamaasiisi kuulu yasuungunu mu uduku Saatina.
Ka so ngaa imiini li na bakwiili mu likaanda la nde, nde afwaana mu ubaasila bo, na anyaala uha mufunu kwaa libuundu. Mundaa ti, mufunu a libuundu ndila mu ubaasila bakwiili bali ngwanya bo bake.
Bakuutu ba libuundu bali mu ubiti libuundu bubwe, bafwaana uholo buzitu nha yulu a buzitu, vulu-vulu kwaa babali na mufunu waleme wa uyiisi mandaa a Nziaambi.
Mu ngwanya, Mabasonuu ma Ngira mali mu uleele: «Beni utuu pe udibuu munywa a ngoombo mu taanga dia utolo mbutu dia bele», na: «Musiali afwaana ubaa mufutu a nde».
A siingi pe mifuundu mi busa mu mukutu a libuundu, mbiiti imbaangi kia baata boolo so batata kio pe.
So muutu siiri bubi, sieembe nde nha kulu a baata, paa ti bo ka bamono boomo.

Me ni yaabisa kwaa we nha kulu a Nziaambi, nha kulu a Yiisu Kristo na nha kulu a batumu ba Ngiraba nde asoolo: Tumumu mikele mi, kwahele a uba na imbisi a nzo, na a biingisi muutu so ndila mosi mu tala-kiinzi pe.
A naa pe mio nha yulu a muutu mu mawasa, mu uha nde mufunu mutso libuundu. A ba pe itwaari mu masumu ma baata bakimi. Kebe tsieemini a we.
A nywa ndila maamba pe, ka nywa mwaana a mala hoolo, mundaa moonyo wuli ubaakolo we.
Masumu ma baata bamosi mali mu umonuu na yaki-yaki, tswaamina bufuundusu bo. Ka kwaa baata bana, ku mbisa pfuundisi mo mali mu uyabina.
Pili mosi ka, biyiluu bialuulu mu mamabwe bili mu uyabina na yaki-yaki, na so bibili keni a biayabina pe mu mawasa, a bituu pe uba biasweeme.

footnotes.text: 5.10 aswayi mili mia bangaa imiini Kwaa Bayuudayo, uswaa miili mia bieenyi ali iliimbi kia isiaayi Luk 7.44; Yow 13.1-17.
5.14 mutaata ni Saatina so a buu pe mudwaanisi a Yiisu na Ndaa Yimbwe.
